data.summary: Microscopist on 4 field(s): density lower vs DMSO; 7 observations; candidates: Microtubule stabilizers

observations.finding: Treated fields show markedly lower cell density and loss of confluent epithelial sheet seen in DMSO control (259,252 cells at 30/10 uM, 580 at 3 uM vs dense monolayer in f_932e066d9dc7). Remaining cells are rounded, compact and poorly spread with short spiky peripheral extensions vs flat polygonal spread cells in DMSO.

Beta-tubulin (green) signal is dramatically brighter and more focal in treated cells: intense perinuclear rings, bundles and bright dots vs dim diffuse filamentous mesh in DMSO. Texture is coarse/high contrast.
DAPI (blue) nuclei are smaller, more condensed and brighter in treated cells; increased frequency of rounded mitotic-like figures with highly condensed chromatin vs large ovoid pale nuclei in DMSO.
Tubulin texture contrast/bundling increased dose-dependently strongest at 30 uM and 10 uM.
Nuclei smaller in area and shorter major axis than DMSO nuclei, with slightly more irregular/bilobed contours; at 3 uM some bi-nucleated enlarged cells are visible.

F-actin (red) cortical stress fibers prominent in DMSO are largely absent in treated cells at 30/10 uM; only faint punctate red signal at periphery remains. At 3 uM some cortical actin returns but remains reduced vs DMSO.
Imaging artifact in f_3a20f6e4bc71 (3 uM): diffuse intense blue haze/background covering left ~30% of field, non-biological, not present in DMSO or other treated fields.

notable_cells.why: example cluster of bright green bundled microtubule asters surrounding condensed mitotic-like nuclei
example of bi-nucleated / irregular nuclei persisting at 3 uM despite overall rounding
region of artificial blue background/illumination artifact

candidate_mechanisms.why: massively increased tub_mean (z 33-58), tub_std (z 28-47) and tub_glcm_contrast (z 61-171) indicating polymerized/bundled microtubules, combined with increased frac_mitotic_like (z 22-36), increased nuc_dna_mean (z 22-30) indicating condensed chromatin/mitotic arrest, and decreased nuc_area/major_axis indicating rounded condensed nuclei; opposite of expected for destabilizers and not the enlarged polyploid nuclei typical of Aurora inhibition. Dose response preserved from 30 to 3 uM.

report.uncertainty: Composite-only view limits fine spindle polarity assessment; Eg5 vs stabilizer both cause mitotic rounding but huge tubulin intensity/bundling favors stabilizer. Actin reduction is visible but not directly quantified (act_std increase likely reflects high green spillover/contrast, not increased stress fibers). Blue haze at 3 uM is artifact and should be excluded.

reflection.text:
Unblinded truth is latrunculin B (PubChem CID 6436219) - Actin disruptors. We called Microtubule stabilizers p=0.68. Incorrect.

What evidence actually got it right:
- e6 compare_to_reference_atlas: NSC vote Actin disruptors 3/4 wells. k-neighbour also had Actin disruptors 3/10 vs Eg5 4/10 - i.e. split, not stabilizer-dominant. We listed it as contradicting evidence in hypothesis_history step 14 and then discounted it.
- Lookup after unblinding e16/e17 confirmed name and BBBC021 structure agree for latrunculin B, mechanisms none curated in ChEMBL. No DB shortcut was available - literature was needed.
- Post-unblinding search: 'latrunculin actin polymerization inhibition' returned 576 hits /5 returned, consistent with established mechanism PMID 3556584 on inhibition of actin polymerization by latrunculin A. We had searched the narrow phrase 'latrunculin B actin disruptor mechanism G-actin binding' pre-unblinding and got 0 hits and then stopped weighting that hypothesis.

What misled us and why:
- Extreme tubulin metrics drove the call: e2 w_c888e7bb46 30uM tub_glcm_contrast z=+171.3, tub_mean z=+57.9, tub_std z=+47.4; e5 10uM +151.6/+50.0/+43.2; e4 3uM +61.6/+33.5 + frac_mitotic_like z=+36.8. With e7 rho=+1.00 p=0 for tub_mean and e11 rho=+1.00 for tub_glcm_contrast over 4 doses we interpreted as monotonic polymerization/bundling. Review critique quoted the same.
- We treated that as primary biology of a stabilizer. In retrospect for an actin disruptor, cell rounding, volume condensation and loss of spreading artefactually concentrates tubulin signal and increases intensity/contrast/texture without direct microtubule polymerization. That crosstalk category exists in literature PMID 42192127 for microtubule-actomyosin crosstalk, and our own search for 'actin microtubule crosstalk phenotypic profiling' returned 1 hit we did not follow.
- e10 describe_phenotype candidate list = Microtubule stabilizers (density lower vs DMSO) was a visual impression on 4 fields, not a quantitative actin read-out. We used it as support e10 for stabilizer while it was plausibly secondary rounding.
- We did not have any direct actin-channel features acquired in e2-e5 to contradict the tubulin signal. Acquisition choice was the core error: we sampled only 4 wells, all at 1,3,10,30 uM (doses 4-7, rep 1 only) - the high-toxic range where e12 cell_count rho=-1.00 p=0, 702 cells at 1uM -> 252-259 cells at 10-30uM. We never sampled doses 0.01-0.3 uM to see actin-specific morphology before collapse.

What we missed / down-weighted:
- e8 frac_mitotic_like rho=+0.20 p=0.8 over the same 4 wells: no monotonic mitotic arrest, inconsistent with a classic stabilizer dose-response. We listed Eg5/Aurora as low probability but did not apply the same falsification to stabilizer.
- e9 frac_multinucleate_proxy rho=-0.80 p=0.2 and e3 at 1uM nuc_solidity z=-18.3, form_factor -12.3, area -10.4: irregular/small nuclei at low-mid dose not explained by simple mitotic arrest. We assigned that to Aurora 0.03 and ignored for actin.
- The magnitude itself: z= +151 to +171 for tub_glcm_contrast is >10 sigma beyond typical stabilizer reference; should have flagged assay artefact (cell loss, fewer cells measured, rounding) rather than stronger biology. With n=4 wells and 1 replicate/dose, rho=+1.00 p=0 is over-confident and driven by the same high-dose artefact.

Lesson: when NSC atlas 3/4 votes actin despite extreme tubulin z-scores, suspect actin-driven secondary tubulin concentration/crosstalk, sample the low dose range, and demand actin-specific features + phospho-H3/tubulin polymerization controls before calling stabilizer.
